text_block_list.text:
One weekend, on my way out, I passed by 
the Academy gate…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
D-D-D-Don't do something so soft in the 
middle of town, you idiot!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
D-Dammit… If we don't hurry, we're gonna 
run out of photo books!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you! Don't you know how to avoid the 
guys on the main street?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
A side road…! Oh, right! I forgot there 
was another way!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It's a bit of a mess, but it can't be 
helped! Hurry up and go around!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
…Just so you know, I'm not scared of you 
or anything! Don't get the wrong idea!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Sprinting at full speed……! You want me to 
run through before I see you!?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
No, I can do it! I can do it! I can run 
faster than the light!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
…No, don't be scared. I just hate soft 
stuff! Don't get the wrong idea!
